studies.actual_method: Reflection diagnoses failures and evolves complementary prompts from a Pareto set.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Retain measured search errors as revision evidence; edit instruction and demonstrations separately.
studies.limitation: v8.5 is an original adaptation, not the GEPA implementation or a reproduced GEPA benchmark.

studies.study: More Than What Was Chosen / C-APO
studies.actual_method: Reconciles revealed and coherent preference signals with a conflict-aware training objective after SFT.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Motivates distinguishing useful task evidence from conflicting shortcut signals.
studies.limitation: C-APO means conflict-aware direct preference optimization, not cost-aware prompt optimization. We do not import its DPO loss or train model weights.

studies.actual_method: Counterfactually refines textual recommendation guidelines to suppress popularity-driven components while retaining preference evidence.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Use evidence-preserving task-specific guidance and observed WinoBias pair failures.
studies.limitation: Recommendation popularity is different from demographic classification fairness. We do not claim to implement the NPRec causal estimator.

studies.study: RosePO: Customized Preference Alignment in LLM-Based Recommendation
studies.actual_method: Customized rejected sampling and personalized label smoothing handle uncertain preference pairs during model alignment.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Supports caution about noisy pairwise comparisons; retain existing paired uncertainty tests.
studies.limitation: Its training loss and user oracle are not directly applicable to fixed-model discrete prompt search.

studies.study: Metric-Fair Prompting: Treating Similar Samples Similarly
studies.actual_method: Pairs similar medical questions for joint inference and promotes consistency under a task-relevant metric.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Retrieve related gold demonstrations and use observed paired-error feedback.
studies.limitation: Medical individual fairness is not our group fairness metric. No embedding model, joint-test inference, Lipschitz certificate or extra free predictions is added.

studies.study: Cost-aware LLM-based Online Dataset Annotation / CaMVo
studies.actual_method: Selects model subsets using contextual confidence and cost before weighted voting.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Preserve explicit cost accounting and avoid inference for cached stability diagnostics or deterministic demo edits.
studies.limitation: Cross-model routing and majority voting would alter the current single-model comparison, so are deferred.

studies.actual_method: Combines fairness-aware AutoML, domain constraints and argumentation; code evaluates stratified cross-validation and group metrics.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Use explicit task-relevant constraints and examine sensitivity across observed search blocks.
studies.limitation: Leave-one-block-out prompt diagnostics are not the same as HAMLET cross-validation or a statistical guarantee.

studies.study: Rethinking Fairness in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: A Survey
studies.actual_method: Distinguishes fairness targets, bias sources, mitigation stages and evaluation limitations.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Keep group definitions and dataset-specific metrics explicit; report all trade-offs.
studies.limitation: Survey evidence does not prove a particular optimizer will outperform.

studies.study: From Bias to Fairness: Mitigating Popularity Bias via SFT and DPO
studies.actual_method: Caps popularity-skewed training data and uses QLoRA SFT followed by DPO on MovieLens.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Supports diverse, gold-labeled example selection rather than repeatedly selecting the same dominant examples.
studies.limitation: Small recommendation setting; requires weight updates; not a directly transferable prompt optimizer or evidence of demographic fairness.

studies.study: Bias Ahead: Sensitive Prompts as Early Warnings
studies.actual_method: SensY and a prompt-sensitivity classifier address fairness risk detection before deployment.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Use it to distinguish sensitivity detection from measured fairness mitigation.
studies.limitation: A sensitivity classifier is not an objective optimizer; adding it would not establish accuracy/fairness gains.

studies.study: Bias by Prompt LLM Fairness repository
studies.actual_method: Contrasts neutral and emotional fairness framing on the same HMDA summary.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Prefer measured error feedback and task evidence over emotional appeals to fairness.
studies.limitation: Exploratory project, not evidence of a universally effective optimizer.

studies.actual_method: Scores FAIR environmental-data principles: Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability and Reusability.
studies.limitation: The FAIR acronym here does not refer to demographic fairness.

studies.actual_method: Trains reward models subject to demographic, equalized-odds or counterfactual constraints.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Motivates explicit fairness constraints and transparent utility trade-offs.
studies.limitation: No reward-model training is added; its certificates do not transfer to our prompt heuristics.

studies.actual_method: Defines intent-aware fairness test cases and structured input variants.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Preserve official paired WinoBias units in feedback, splits and bootstrap.
studies.limitation: We reuse existing observed pairs, not automated semantic fairness judgments or uncounted synthetic evaluations.

studies.actual_method: Investigates failure attribution and the limitations of reflective prompt optimization.
studies.transfer_to_trifair: Retain diagnostics explaining what errors and measurements informed a proposal.
studies.limitation: Existing v8.3 already used failure attribution; this is not claimed as a new v8.5 invention.
